en.parcel_delivery_box_description: A street stop where box vans load and unload parcels only. A parcel drop box appears next to it and collects the parcels of the residents in its range; residential districts in its range receive parcels.
en.parcel_delivery_post_description: A mailbox on the sidewalk that collects the parcels of the residents around it. It is connected to the street by a very short entrance. Box vans load the parcels at a parcel mailbox stop next to it.
en.parcel_delivery_drop_warehouse_descripti: The goods warehouse of the base game with a parcel stock, placed without collision. A trial.
en.parcel_delivery_drop_range_test_descript: The parcel drop box showing its collection range while it is placed. A trial.
en.parcel_delivery_drop_description: A mailbox on the sidewalk that collects the parcels of the residents around it. Every parcel delivery point gets one by itself; box vans load its parcels at the delivery point.
en.parcel_delivery_office_description: A post office at the street with its own loading point for box vans. It collects the parcels of the residents around it; lines of box vans stop here to load them and deliver them to residential districts.
en.parcel_delivery_sorting_export_descripti: Takes the parcels of the town and turns them into long distance parcels. Build it next to a train station or an airport: box vans unload the parcels here, trains and planes load the long distance parcels and take them to the import center of another town.
en.parcel_delivery_sorting_import_descripti: Takes the long distance parcels and turns them back into parcels. Build it next to a train station or an airport: trains and planes unload the long distance parcels here, box vans load the parcels and deliver them to the residential districts of the town.
en.parcel_delivery_sorting_per_year: Up to %d parcels per year at the current productivity
en.parcel_delivery_sorting_input: The stations whose range covers the sorting center unload the cargo here.
en.parcel_delivery_sorting_output: The stations whose range covers the sorting center load the converted cargo here.
en.parcel_delivery_rate_tooltip: Parcels sent by the residents around a parcel drop box. 1x: 50 parcels per 100 residents and year.
en.parcel_delivery_demand_tooltip: How many parcels the residential districts of a town take. 1x: about as many parcels as residents. Only applies to a new game.
en.parcel_delivery_business_tooltip: Commercial and industrial buildings around a parcel drop box send parcels when they are supplied: 0.5 parcels per unit of cargo supplied.
en.parcel_delivery_business_rate_tooltip: Parcels sent by the commercial and industrial buildings around a parcel drop box. 1x: 0.5 parcels per unit of cargo supplied.
en.parcel_delivery_radius_tooltip: Range of the parcel delivery points and their drop boxes, 1x is that of a street stop (160 m): the residents and businesses in it send parcels. A building in the range of several drop boxes counts for the one built first. Built delivery points take a new range when they are rebuilt.
en.parcel_delivery_office_per_year: About %d parcels per year (residents and businesses in the range)
en.parcel_delivery_office_input: Residents and businesses in the range send the parcels.
en.parcel_delivery_office_output: Lines take the parcels to the residential districts in the catchment of their stops.
en.parcel_delivery_line_total: Total: %d parcels waiting for this line
en.parcel_delivery_time_tooltip: Time to deliver a parcel, the same as a cargo of the base game. Parcels delivered with more than half of the time left earn up to 1.2x the price of other cargo, later ones down to 0.8x.

zh_TW.parcel_delivery_box_description: 路邊的包裹投遞處，只裝卸包裹。旁邊會自動出現一個包裹投遞箱，收集範圍內居民寄出的包裹；範圍內的住宅區可以收件。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_post_description: 立在人行道上的郵筒，收集附近居民寄出的包裹，以極短的入口道路接上街道。箱型貨車在旁邊的包裹郵筒站牌取件。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_drop_warehouse_descripti: 原版的貨物倉庫加上包裹庫存，忽略碰撞放置。測試用。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_drop_range_test_descript: 放置時會顯示收件範圍的包裹投遞箱。測試用。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_drop_description: 立在人行道上的郵筒，收集附近居民寄出的包裹。每個包裹投遞處旁邊會自動出現一個，箱型貨車在包裹投遞處取件。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_office_description: 蓋在路邊的郵局，附有箱型貨車的裝貨點。郵局收集附近居民寄出的包裹，箱型貨車路線停靠這裡裝貨，送往住宅區。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_sorting_export_name: 跨城包裹分揀中心（出口）
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_sorting_export_descripti: 接收城鎮的包裹，轉換成長距離運輸的包裹。蓋在火車站或機場旁邊：箱型貨車把包裹卸在這裡，火車和飛機裝上長距離包裹，運到其他城鎮的進口分揀中心。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_sorting_import_name: 跨城包裹分揀中心（進口）
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_sorting_import_descripti: 接收長距離運輸的包裹，轉換回一般包裹。蓋在火車站或機場旁邊：火車和飛機把長距離包裹卸在這裡，箱型貨車裝上包裹，送到城鎮的住宅區。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_sorting_per_year: 以目前效率，每年最多轉換 %d 個
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_sorting_input: 範圍涵蓋分揀中心的車站把貨物卸在這裡。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_sorting_output: 範圍涵蓋分揀中心的車站從這裡裝走轉換後的貨物。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_rate_tooltip: 包裹投遞箱範圍內居民寄出的包裹數量。1 倍：每 100 位居民每年 50 個包裹。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_demand_tooltip: 城鎮住宅區接收的包裹數量。1 倍時需求量約與人口相當。只在開新遊戲時套用。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_business_tooltip: 包裹投遞箱範圍內的商業區與工業區建築獲得供應後寄出包裹：每供應 1 單位貨物產生 0.5 個包裹。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_business_rate_tooltip: 包裹投遞箱範圍內商業區與工業區建築寄出的包裹數量。1 倍：每供應 1 單位貨物產生 0.5 個包裹。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_radius_tooltip: 包裹投遞處與其投遞箱的收件範圍，1 倍是路邊站牌的範圍（160 公尺）。範圍內的居民與商工業會寄出包裹；一棟建築同時在好幾個投遞箱的範圍內時，算給最早蓋好的那一個。已蓋好的包裹投遞處要重建才會套用新範圍。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_office_per_year: 每年約 %d 個包裹（範圍內的居民與商工業）
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_office_input: 範圍內的居民與商工業寄出包裹。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_office_output: 路線把包裹送到各停靠站範圍內的住宅區。
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_line_total: 合計：%d 個包裹等待這條路線運送
zh_TW.parcel_delivery_time_tooltip: 包裹的配送時限，與所選的原版貨物相同。剩餘時間超過一半時送達，價格最高是一般貨物的 1.2 倍；送得越晚越便宜，最低 0.8 倍。
